name: workzen-tooling
description: Repo-wide git hooks and formatting. Not a workspace: client/ and backend/ keep their own dependencies.

scripts.lint: bun run --cwd client lint && bun run --cwd backend lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd client typecheck && bun run --cwd backend typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd client build && bun run --cwd backend build
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build
